title: ILSpy color theme
description: A color theme. Comments and trailing commas are allowed. The file's name without .json is the theme's id.

name.description: The name the theme is listed by: one for every language, or one per language tag, such as en or pt-BR, where English stands in for a language without one.

type.description: Whether the theme is dark or light. A theme that extends no other takes the code and icon colors of the built-in theme of its type.

extends.description: The id of a built-in or user theme to build on; what this theme leaves out comes from it.

palette.description: Named colors the ui, code and icons sections can use by name. A theme's palette is merged over those of the themes it extends.

ui.description: The interface's colors. Required unless an extended theme sets them: background, surface, control, field, border, text, textMuted, accent, onAccent. The others are derived from these when left out.

background.description: The workspace: the window, trees and lists.

surface.description: Docked chrome: menu bar, main toolbar, tab strip, status bar. A pane's own body and toolbar use paneBackground.

control.description: The base of neutral buttons and segments.

controlHovered.description: Derived from other colors, or a default, when unset.

controlPressed.description: Derived from other colors, or a default, when unset.

editorBackground.description: A document or code view's background.

paneBackground.description: A docked pane's body, which its selected tab, toolbar and table header share so the tab reads as attached to what is below it.

paneToolbarBackground.description: A toolbar along the top of a pane.

tableHeaderBackground.description: The column headings of a table.

tabStripBackground.description: The strip behind a pane's tabs.

tabActiveBackground.description: The selected tab, joined to its pane.

tabHoverBackground.description: An unselected tab under the pointer.

borderStrong.description: An outline that answers the pointer: a hovered field, a hovered splitter.

separator.description: Structural divisions between panes and groups.

textDisabled.description: Text of a control that cannot be used.

accent.description: Primary filled actions and checked state.

accentHovered.description: Derived from other colors, or a default, when unset.

accentPressed.description: Derived from other colors, or a default, when unset.

accentText.description: Links and activity text, readable on background.

focusRing.description: The ring a widget holding keyboard focus draws.

rowHover.description: An unselected row under the pointer.

selection.description: Selected rows, segments and highlighted menu items in the focused pane.

selectionInactive.description: A selection whose pane does not hold focus.

textSelection.description: Selected text, distinct from selection so it shows on a selected row.

danger.description: Derived from other colors, or a default, when unset.

dangerSurface.description: Derived from other colors, or a default, when unset.

onDanger.description: Text on a solid danger badge.

warning.description: Derived from other colors, or a default, when unset.

warningSurface.description: Derived from other colors, or a default, when unset.

success.description: Derived from other colors, or a default, when unset.

scrim.description: The backdrop dimming what is behind a modal dialog.

scrollThumb.description: Derived from other colors, or a default, when unset.

scrollThumbHovered.description: Derived from other colors, or a default, when unset.

scrollThumbHeld.description: Derived from other colors, or a default, when unset.

popupShadowColor.description: The shadow under menus, context menus and tooltips.

dialogShadowColor.description: The shadow under a modal dialog's card.

code.description: The code view's colors. Those left out come from the theme extended, else from the built-in theme of the type.

currentLine.description: The background of the caret's line, when it is highlighted.

matchingBracket.description: The background of the bracket at the caret and the one matching it.

bookmark.description: The gutter mark of an enabled bookmark.

icons.description: The tree's icon colors. Those left out come from the theme extended, else from the built-in theme of the type.

restricted.description: The color of the accessibility overlay on non-public nodes' icons.

hexColor.description: #RRGGBB, or #RRGGBBAA with alpha. #00000000 reads as unset, so it is refused; for an invisible color write another transparent one, such as #FFFFFF00.

anyOf.description: The name of a palette color.
